text:
Eva: Quick kitflow snapshot — where do we stand on quant recs, KV-cache shadowing, and canary gating? Also saw a regression alert for small-batch p50 in staging. Can owners please confirm status and next milestone? Thanks.

Mike: I'll own quant recs. PR #1345 is the draft — plan is LLM-variant PTQ 4-bit with 8-bit fallback for >2048 tokens. Need perf table from perf-run-4. ETA Friday.

Jasper: KV-cache shadowing is blocked on an invalidation bug I found. Working on fix; ETA EOD tomorrow. Test plan: 1) shadow 24h traffic 2) compare cache hit ratio and token cost. Assigning to me for now.

Sophia: I can wire the canary to flags. Proposed rollout: 10% traffic for 4h with p50/p95 & error-rate alarms. Anyone opposed?

InfraBot: ALERT: staging small-batch p50 latency increased from 60ms -> 110ms since 1767650000.ID:stg-lat-3401. Dashboard: https://dash/reports/stg-lat-3401 :fire_engine:

Mike: Hmm, I reverted the batching heuristic in staging 48h ago, could be related. I'll repro locally and check perf-run-4 logs.

Eva: Mike — can you post a minimal repro (curl) and the small payload so Jasper/Sophia can run the same? Also tag me when you find root cause.

Jasper: repro below — runs against staging endpoint and hits the small-batch path:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/llama-3-8b","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":64,"batch_size":1}'
```

Sophia: If it's batcher-related we should add a short-lived gating rule: if p50 > 90ms on small-batch for 15m, auto-roll back to previous binpack. I can add that to the flag config.

Mike: Running smoke now: `make smoke-staging` — quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:01Z] request id=... p50=112ms p95=280ms
[2026-03-17T03:12:05Z] request id=... p50=105ms p95=265ms
```

Mike: Looks like p50 is consistently ~110ms. Diffs in perf-run-4 show higher scheduling latency when batch_size==1 after the heuristic change.

Eva: Ok ownership recap: quant recs -> Mike; KV cache shadowing & invalidation -> Jasper; canary/flagging + rollback rule -> Sophia; Eva will follow up on cross-team communication and timeline. Please update PRs/flags by EOD tomorrow or ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:

Sophia: acked, will draft flag rule and add alert thresholds. :eyes:

Mike: will push a hotfix branch for the batcher heuristic, link PR when ready.

Jasper: will validate invalidation fix against Mike's repro once the fix is up.

Eva: thanks all — small follow-up: can we add a short note in the release doc about the staging regression and the mitigation plan? I'll create a follow-up thread. :memo:
